title: Kessdona's Perch
summary: Exhaust Kessdona's manashards, then identify the correct protector at each health lock.
overview: Exhaust Kessdona's manashards, then identify the correct protector at each health lock.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Assign someone to identify the true protector and avoid indiscriminate area damage on protector groups.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: While manashards remain active, reaching 90% heals Kessdona and drains their resources. Defeat the depleted guardians to progress.
At 80%, 60%, 40% and 20%, protectors hold her health in place.
Find and defeat the true focus among each protector group. Killing a wrong protector restores health and restarts that stage.
She also uses a charm timer; leaving combat triggers failure cleanup after 30 seconds.

notes: Approval E325. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
